Marketing.headline: A clean monorepo base for reliable WhatsApp AI operations.
Marketing.subheadline: The repo now ships with a Turbo workspace, a localized Next.js shell, a Cloudflare Worker ingress shell, and shared workspace packages prepared for the later Convex, Clerk, and WhatsApp phases.

cards.foundationBody: Single repo with apps and packages wired for phase-by-phase delivery.
cards.i18nBody: next-intl is initialized with locale-aware routing from day one.
cards.ingressBody: Hono and Wrangler are in place with local, staging, and production placeholders.

Marketing.shellFootnote: Later phases will replace placeholders with Clerk auth, Convex persistence, webhook verification, queue orchestration, and production observability.

Dashboard.headline: Auth, Bot Studio, and Knowledge Base are now live inside the dashboard.
Dashboard.subheadline: The repo has moved past shell-only delivery. Tenancy, localized bot configuration, and markdown-first knowledge ingestion are in place before WhatsApp transport phases begin.

botStudio.title: Bot Studio
botStudio.body: Prompt, language, model, safety, and preview controls are active.

knowledgeBase.title: Knowledge Base
knowledgeBase.body: Inline and website knowledge now ingest into markdown chunks and embeddings.

inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.body: Conversation surfaces, handoff, and service-window UX land in phases 7 to 10.

ops.title: Ops
ops.body: Queue visibility, webhook state, and monitoring expand across phases 6 to 14.

checklist.repo: pnpm workspace and Turbo remain the repo backbone.
checklist.web: Next.js App Router, Tailwind, and next-intl power the localized dashboard.
checklist.ingress: Ingress stays minimal while WhatsApp verification and raw persistence wait for later phases.
checklist.shared: Convex auth, RBAC, Bot Studio, and Knowledge Base surfaces are wired end to end.

Dashboard.nextStepsBody: Phase 5 adds WhatsApp integration credentials, encrypted setup state, and audit-ready connection management.
